title: Young Boy in Overcoat and Cap in Backyard, 1952 B&W Vintage Photo
description: A full-length outdoor snapshot from May 1952 capturing a young boy standing in a grassy yard beside garden shrubs and a white trellised house wall. He is dressed in a smart buttoned overcoat, light-colored cap, and two-tone saddle shoes with ankle socks. The print features classic mid-century deckled (scalloped) borders.
